abstract: The ubiquitous availability of protein structures permits replacing sequence alignment with more accurate and sensitive structure alignment algorithms. LoL-align maximizes a local log-odds score for proteins to be homologous, given their intra-protein C - C distances. LoL-align is markedly more sensitive in detecting remote homologs than TMalign and DALI on single- and multi-domain benchmarks and achieves better alignment quality at 5-20x their speed. LoL-align is fully integrated into Foldseek.
